verdict.rationale: Stripe Issuing has a documented public API reference covering card and cardholder creation, real-time authorization decisioning, funding and disputes. The docs describe it as the Stripe Issuing API, and community comments independently call it an API-first product. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (every probed openapi/swagger path returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Creates a new Issuing `Cardholder` object that can be issued cards.
Use the Stripe Issuing API to create, manage, and distribute payment cards for your business.
Stripe offers a guided Dashboard process and an API to submit disputes and monitor them through to resolution.
Stripe Issuing is an API-first product
